result.title: LMnOP: Pruning 3D Gaussian Splatting via Leave-Many-Out Importance
result.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting renders photorealistic views in real time. However, a single scene often needs millions of Gaussians, so these models are costly to store and render. Pruning reduces this cost by keeping a subset of the Gaussians. A common score is the leave-one-out importance, which is the loss increase when a Gaussian alone is removed. At high pruning ratios, many Gaussians are removed together, so Gaussians that are redundant alone but essential together are lost. We present LMnOP (Leave-Many-Out Pruning), which estimates the importance of each Gaussian under the removal of the other Gaussians. This leave-many-out importance is the average loss increase when a Gaussian is removed while the others are also removed at random. We compute the exact mean and variance of each pixel's color under random removal in closed form, and approximate the importance from them without sampling removal patterns. We refine each Gaussian's probability of remaining with its importance and prune once at the end. Without fine-tuning, LMnOP achieves the best results in 16 of 18 metrics on three datasets at 90% and 99% removal. It improves SSIM and LPIPS over GaussianPOP in all 13 scenes.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 LMnOP，用于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的剪枝：以「移除其他高斯时某高斯的重要性」替代逐个移除的 leave-one-out 分数，通过闭式求出随机移除下像素颜色的均值与方差来近似该重要性，无采样、无微调，在 90%/99% 移除率下取得较好结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是「单独移除时冗余、共同移除时关键」的联合移除重要性与闭式近似，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中视觉 token 或 latent 状态的贡献分配与冗余/信息坍缩诊断。
